verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a team collaboration product like Basecamp, so the axis applies. The evidence lists message boards, chat, to-dos, card tables (kanban), Hill Charts and file storage, including Figma files, but no whiteboard or freeform visual canvas. Card tables and stored Figma links are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
